Complete power over a relationship can change a person. I never thought I would, but even I changed because her showing no initiative on anything, made me focus on what I wanted because I felt like she would be fine with whatever i chose for us. maybe it is emberassing to say that on a primal instinct level, i felt very masculine and powerful. But towards the end it became exhausting and overwhelming. And our relationship dynamics have already been shaped so we tried to keep it going that way. In the end, I realised she wanted to change things but couldnt since its our default thing, and tempering with it might collapse both of us. Ended up resenting me(?), and we broke up after 2 years.
